title: Does Madeira Have Tides, and Do They Matter on a Boat Trip?
description: Madeira has two highs and two lows a day, ranging in Funchal from under 1 m on neap tides to just over 2 m on springs. Why boats barely notice and who should.
heroAlt: Wet pebbles and exposed rock ledges at low tide on the beach at Ponta do Sol
keywords: do tides matter for a boat trip

images.prompt: Early morning at low tide on the pebble beach of Ponta do Sol: wet grey and black stones glistening, a band of exposed dark rock ledges at the water's edge, small calm waves, the white houses of the village and its cliff behind in soft low light. True colours, no people, no boats, no text.
